We're finalizing an Acme public case study that highlights our work with Redwood Inference. Legal and procurement have asked for copies of your SOC 2 and ISO attestations (or a pointer to the public reports) so we can include a short compliance section in the case study and attach evidence for our auditors.

If you can send the artifacts and any standard language we can use (or an approval contact), that would speed things up. We're aiming to publish the case study late next week.
